Name: Eight Slices
Author: coola101
Description:
Adds a new farm to the game using DeLiXx's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13804?tab=description]Custom Farm Loader[/url] to patch the farm into the game without replacing vanilla farms.

[b][u]Features
[/u][/b]The map is split into eight areas with a center point. Most of the eight areas are based upon one of the vanilla farm types and receive some of their attributes. Shortcuts can be unlocked between each region through the use of Iron Tools.
[b]Northwest - Hilltop
[/b] - Limited space divided by a cliff.
 - Grandpa's Shrine
 - Quarry
 - Small river with fishing chances comparable to the Hilltop Farm Stream
[b]North - Wilderness*
[/b] - Pond
 - Backwoods entrance
 - Reasonably small, but open, area
 - Proficient fighters have a chance to fish up valued treasures from the pond
[b]Northeast - Standard
[/b] - Bus Stop entrance
 - Plenty of space
[b]East - Riverland
[/b] - Fishing chances comparable to the Riverland Farm
 - Limited space split between several islands
[b]Southeast - Beach
[/b] - No sprinklers in sandy soil
 - Beach spawns similar to the beach farm
 - Fishing chances comparable to the Beach Farm
 - Oceanic Crab Pots!
[b]South - Meadowland
[/b] - Blue grass patches
 - Cindersap Forest entrance
 - Acceptable amount of space
[b]Southwest - Woodland
[/b] - One daily respawning hardwood stump
 - Forageable spawns
 - Chance for weeds to be transformed to the special variant which drop Wild Seeds
 - Wide open space, although partly dominated by grass and foliage
[b]West - ???
[/b] - Farm Cave & Greenhouse
 - Partly able to spawn weeds and forage from the Southwest

[b][u]Requirements[/u][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13804?tab=description]Custom Farm Loader

[/url][b][u]Recommendations
[/u][/b]I highly suggest [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23168/]Seasonal Bridge[/url], a supplementary mod I made specifically for Eight Slices. In the Northwestern area, the suspension bridge from one of the "island" tilesets is used. This same bridge lacks a proper spring/fall/winter form, so I made one.
[b]IF[/b] you do not use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23168/]Seasonal Bridge [/url]or any other mod which replaces the tiles in question, during the Winter season, the Northwest bridge will appear as though it is Summer. During Spring and Fall, the shore and cliffs will not be the appropriate colors to the season.

[b][u]Other
[/u][/b]Although somewhat unprofessional, I felt I should say that this is my first real mod for Stardew Valley. Any criticism, feedback, kind words, and so-on would be highly appreciated!
If you find a bug or some other issue with the map, do feel free to say something.
